attribution: The four relevant publication/teardown/policy/receiver-timing methods are byte-identical between f903f59a and the retained-core pre-fix live transfer.go. f903 also reaches transferFlightPolicy from estimateSendWindow. The ownership defect is present at this pre-retention baseline; a historical f903 race binary has not been run.
fix: A leaf mutex guards worker pointer stores and the copied handle in transferFlightPolicy. The worker remains sole lifecycle writer; all external RouteManager/provider calls run after the mutex is released.

reader_audit.ack_worker: coalesceReceivedAck validates/publishes service via queue and service locks. observeItemAck is reached from receiveAckFeedbackAt on the send worker, after the ack worker has coalesced messages; teardown joins the ack worker before closing the writer.
reader_audit.concurrent: DestinationSendStats calls sendWindowSnapshot, which calls estimateSendWindow and receiverWindowTiming. Every external policy read is routed through transferFlightPolicy.
reader_audit.fast_path: NoAck callers use their separately atomic noAckFastPath snapshot; they do not read contractMultiRouteWriter.
reader_audit.lifetime: Production windowPacer.service is attached before the sequence is published and is not cleared during teardown; only its separately buffer-locked reference count changes.
